description: Return one RoutersUA information page as published (Ukrainian, Markdown-like text) with its page URL and the store's telephone, email, address and contacts page. Use it for questions about delivery cost, payment methods, returns and exchange, privacy or who runs the store; for ship and delivery dates use routersua_estimate_delivery, and for branches or lockers routersua_find_delivery_points. Choose topic delivery-and-payment for delivery cost and payment, returns-and-exchange for returns and exchange, privacy-policy for personal data, about for the store. Warranty terms per product are in the specifications of routersua_get_product.

topic.description: delivery-and-payment: delivery methods and cost, payment methods; returns-and-exchange; privacy-policy; about: the store and its contacts.

name: routersua_get_store_policy
